title: The Toad Who Grew by Halves
story: Hobswallow has wedged himself into the millpond's water gate, and every hour he gulps air and puffs up 50% heavier, squeezing the gate shut while the village gardens go dry. Mr 6 can pop him loose with the gate-winch, but the winch must be set to the toad's exact weight or the chain will snap. The miller says the winch crew cannot arrive for three more hours — right now Hobswallow weighs 16 pounds.
question: If Hobswallow grows 50% heavier every hour for the next 3 hours, how many pounds will he weigh when the winch is finally set?
solution: Growing 50% heavier means multiplying by 1.5, so after 1 hour he is 16 × 1.5 = 24 pounds.
After 2 hours: 24 × 1.5 = 36 pounds. After 3 hours: 36 × 1.5 = 54 pounds.
Mr 6 sets the winch for 54 pounds.
praise: Multiplying by 1.5 was exactly the right move — the growth just had to happen three separate times, each one on the newer, bigger weight.
hint: 50% heavier means the new weight is 1.5 times the old weight. Do that once for each hour, always using the latest weight.
victory: The winch pulled at precisely 54 pounds and Hobswallow popped free like a cork, bouncing twice across the pond before drifting off, burping politely. The gardens drank all afternoon.
imagePrompt: A moonlit millpond where an enormously puffed-up green toad is wedged in a wooden water gate while a brave walking numeral 6 in a knight helmet and blue cape measures him with a rope, silvery light on the still water.
